headline: Kai, the Fed's September minutes land this afternoon with the ten-year at 5.33% and the S&P fresh off its first close above 7,800.
subline: Hormuz has Brent back above $101; bitcoin slipped below $84,000 overnight; Monday's hot PMIs gave the bond market something to chew on.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:45 AM ET, futures from a 4 AM read · gold at Tuesday's settle · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Fed minutes land with the 10-year at 5.33%
items.sentence: Minutes from the September FOMC meeting arrive this afternoon alongside consumer credit data, per Finviz's week-ahead, with the 10-year at 5.33% — near 24-year highs and up more than 110 basis points this year, per TradingEconomics.

items.title: S&P 500 posts first close above 7,800
items.sentence: Tuesday ended at a record 7,818.93, up 0.58%, with the Dow at 51,521.28 and the Nasdaq at 27,599.79, as easing oil and a small retreat in yields let AI earnings growth lead again, per TheStreet.

items.title: Brent holds above $101 despite supply fixes
items.sentence: Brent trades at $101.67 this morning and WTI at $89.86, per TradingEconomics, even as G7 reserve releases and Gulf exports running above pre-war levels lean against the Hormuz risk premium, per Invezz.

items.title: Bitcoin breaks below $84,000 on Gulf risk
items.sentence: Bitcoin trades at $83,754 after briefly dipping below $84,000 overnight, down 2.57% over 24 hours, per CoinDesk. That is a drop of about $2,211 per coin in a day, which CoinDesk ties to the Gulf escalation while its analyst note still calls the longer stair-step uptrend intact.

items.title: Hot PMIs set up a quiet earnings week
items.sentence: Futures are little changed after Monday's ISM services print of 54.9 and a composite PMI of 58.4 — the fastest private-sector expansion in more than five years, with prices rising — per Yahoo Finance, while Finviz's slate this week holds Constellation Brands, Delta, Levi's, PepsiCo and Applied Digital.

items.title: Iran sets seven conditions to reopen Hormuz
items.sentence: Parliament speaker Ghalibaf says reopening rests on seven conditions from the Islamabad memorandum — 'the era of wasting time and dictating unilateral demands is over' — a roadmap Trump has already rejected, per Al Jazeera.

items.title: Trump says the strait belongs to the Navy
items.sentence: Trump called the US naval presence an effective blockade and said the conflict ends the 'nice way' or the 'not-so-nice way,' while Secretary of State Rubio claimed Iran has lost complete control of Hormuz, per WION's live coverage.

items.title: Houthis hit Riyadh; Bab el-Mandeb contested
items.sentence: Yemen's Houthis fired a ballistic missile at Riyadh's King Khalid Airport and claimed hits on Aramco facilities while Saudi-backed forces push to retake the Red Sea coast, with one day's fighting put above 270 dead by sources AFP cites, per CBS News.

items.title: G7 taps 100 million barrels of reserves
items.sentence: The G7 is releasing 100 million barrels of crude and diesel over four months, and Middle East exports have exceeded the pre-war average of about 18 million barrels a day, per Invezz — the supply math holding Brent near its $100 line.

items.title: US declines OSCE monitors for the midterms
items.sentence: The administration will not invite OSCE election observers for November, the first US refusal since 2002 — a step previously taken only by Russia and Belarus among member states, per Heather Cox Richardson's letter.

items.title: AI chiefs won't guarantee agents under oath
items.sentence: At a New York City Council hearing, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta executives declined to promise their agents will always follow safeguards — Anthropic's Logan Graham called the control science 'fundamentally hard and unsettled,' per Fox News.

items.title: Mistral ships a trillion-parameter open model
items.sentence: Mistral Large 4, nicknamed 'Le Chonk,' is a 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts with 49 billion active parameters, trained on 4,000 Grace Blackwell GPUs, with open weights due at the end of October, per AI Weekly.

items.title: Google buys 3,590 MW from Constellation
items.sentence: A 20-year power purchase agreement routes 3,590 megawatts to Google, about a quarter of it new nuclear capacity from 11 reactor upgrades, and triggers more than $4.3 billion of Constellation investment, per AI Weekly.

items.title: Anthropic opens tiered access for cyber defense
items.sentence: A new verification program splits advanced cyber capability into defense, red-team and specialized tiers, after Project Glasswing partners surfaced more than 129,000 software flaws between April and July, per AI Weekly.

items.title: OpenAI claims 372 math results from one prompt
items.sentence: OpenAI says a single-agent prompt produced 372 new mathematical results, nearly all from the one prompt with some requiring repeated attempts, per AI Weekly — peer review will have a busy quarter.
